prompt: A rotating platform is at the right height when $\sin\theta = 0.5$. One answer is $\theta = 30^\circ$. What is the OTHER answer between $0^\circ$ and $360^\circ$? Give it in degrees.
hint: Sine is positive in Quadrant 1 AND Quadrant 2, so the partner answer is in Quadrant 2.

hints.text: Sine is positive in Quadrant 1 AND Quadrant 2, so the partner answer is in Quadrant 2.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Practise the rule with $\sin\theta = 0.7$, first answer about $44^\circ$: the partner is $180 - 44 = 136^\circ$. Now use $180 - 30$.
The partner in Quadrant 2 is $180^\circ - \theta$, so compute $180 - 30$.

explanation: Two points on the unit circle sit at the same height: one in Quadrant 1 and its mirror in Quadrant 2.
The mirror of $\theta$ across the top of the circle is $180^\circ - \theta$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Mirror the picture
steps: Fold the circle along the vertical line through the centre.
The point at 30° lands exactly on the point at 150°. Folding sideways keeps the HEIGHT the same, so both have sine 0.5.

alternativeExplanations.title: The platform rises, then falls
steps: Turning from 0°, the platform rises and hits the target height at 30°.
It keeps rising to the top at 90°, then comes back DOWN and passes the same height again — the same 30° of turn past the top, at 90 + 60 = 150°.
